statement.document_title: Six (or seven) predictions for AI 2026 from a Generative AI realist

our_interpretation: Reliable ordinarily means dependable factual and task performance across common uses, without frequent consequential failures. It does not require literal perfection.
For this ongoing technical state, I use the latest publicly reportable December model evaluations before publication: December 1–20, 2025.
The economics look dubious is a hedged judgment. It specifies neither a company nor a financial measure, and is not a forecast of insolvency.
I retain the complete bundle rather than treating evidence of occasional errors as proof of both clauses.
criteria.support_condition: Representative contemporary evaluations show material reliability failures across common uses. The economic component additionally needs a specified economic test and evidence meeting it.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative evaluations demonstrate dependable performance across the intended uses at an appropriate error tolerance. Resolving the economic component against Marcus requires a specified economic test, not revenue growth alone.
